title: SheetFrame
description: One title-block INSERT and the drawing frame around it -- a single sheet inside a DWG file (docs/contracts/r1.md §1 도곽, §3 `sheet_frame`). One file can carry many frames; entities are assigned to a frame by bbox centre (`frames.yaml` `frame.assign`). A file where no title block was recognised still produces one row, with `kind = "unrecognized_file"` and the whole model-space extent as `bbox`, so the sheet list can show it instead of dropping it silently. This schema is the serialisation of the `sheet_frame` table and of the `before_frame`/`after_frame` summaries embedded in `GET /compare/sets/{id}/pairs`.

titleblock_handle.description: Handle of the title-block INSERT in the working DXF. Null for `unrecognized_file`.

block_name.description: Block definition name of the title block, as written in the DXF.

bbox.description: Frame outline in the working DXF's world coordinates (mm). For `unrecognized_file` this is the model-space extent.

sheet_no.description: Drawing number as read from the title block, raw text (e.g. `A-101`). Null when no number tag matched.

sheet_title.description: Drawing name as read from the title block, raw text.

scale_text.description: Scale as printed in the title block, raw text (e.g. `1:50`, `A1 1/100`).

scale_denominator.description: Denominator parsed out of `scale_text` (`1:50` -> 50). Null when it could not be read; the cloud-mark scale factor is then 1.0 (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §5).

date_text.description: Date as printed in the title block, raw text. Never parsed into `run_date`.

norm_key.description: Normalised `sheet_no` (or the file name when there is none) used for number matching: `frames.yaml` `normalize` applied -- spaces stripped, full-width folded to ASCII, upper-cased, hyphen variants unified.

sort_index.description: Position of the frame inside its file, ordered top-left to bottom-right. Makes the sheet list deterministic when several frames share a number.

entity_handles.description: Handles of the working-DXF entities assigned to this frame, in document order. Omitted from the pairs-list summary because it is large; always present on the full record.

provenance.description: Working DXF and title-block handle this frame came from (CLAUDE.md rule 5). `handle` is the title-block INSERT, or the frame outline entity when there is no title block.

attributes.description: Every ATTRIB of the title block, tag -> value, exactly as read. Keeps the evidence for `sheet_no`/`sheet_title`/`scale_text` reviewable when a tag mapping is wrong.

role.title: FrameRole
role.description: Which side of the revision the frame belongs to: the drawing set before the change, or after it.

frame_kind.title: FrameKind
frame_kind.description: `titleblock` a recognised title block, `unrecognized_file` a whole file that produced no title block at all (docs/contracts/r1.md §3).

bbox.title: CompareBBox
bbox.description: Axis-aligned box as the four numbers `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` in millimetres, `x0 <= x1` and `y0 <= y1`. The compare records use this flat form (docs/contracts/r1.md §3) rather than `common/primitives` `bbox`, because it is what the `clusters.json` sidecar writes and what the viewer feeds straight into `zoomTo`.
